artworks.title: Ruined Two-Story Building with Mountains in Distance
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The landscape presents various structures and surrounding natural scenery from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is in the upper third against a sky filled with swirling clouds. Below is an ancient structure near the center-right. Two figures are on a path near the water's edge in the foreground. To the left are lower buildings extending into the distance, leading to a mountainous area. A small river or stream meanders through the landscape. The technique shows dense, precise line work giving texture to the clouds and trees. The color palette is monochrome with shades of grey, black, and white, typical of ink-based art in this style.

artworks.title: The Enraged Musician
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling street scene full of noise and activity. In the center, a woman carries a large vessel on her head while others around her are engaged in various activities, like playing musical instruments and making noises. On the left, a man leans out of a window. The background shows architectural elements like a church steeple and buildings. There are several objects on the ground and in the hands of the figures, hinting at daily life and trades happening in the street.

artworks.title: Solitudine [Solitude]
artworks.medium: etching with monotype wiping, printed in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a building on a hill, surrounded by trees. The scene is in monochrome with a focus on shadows and textures. The view is slightly elevated, looking down a slope towards the left where the building is located. The sky is heavily shaded, adding to the contrast. The building's sharp architectural details are emphasized. There is a faint glow on the horizon, hinting at a sun. Barren trees in the foreground partially obstruct the view of the building. The brushstrokes are fine and linear, creating an etched appearance. The use of dark tones and some lighter lines enhances the play between shadow and light. The color palette is limited to shades of gray and black, creating a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Januarius (January)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a point of view from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is in the top third of the image, showing hills or low mountains in the distance. A dirt path curves leading to rural buildings with thatched roofs. Beside the path, bare trees reach upwards towards the sky. The image is in black and white, capturing the simplicity and calmness of the scene.

artworks.title: Februarius (February)
artworks.description: The image depicts a village scene from an overhead perspective. The horizon line is formed at the river's edge where it meets the land, and a stone bridge crosses the water. A detailed house with a cone-shaped roof is in the center, surrounded by other structures. Two figures are by the riverbank, while a group tends to a fire on the left. Trees lean dramatically, suggesting wind. The brushstrokes are fine and linear, creating textures for smoke, water, and trees. The image is in monochrome, emphasizing line work and texture.

artworks.title: Martius (March)
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal landscape with a fortress or city on rocky hills in the distance. A tree on the right frames the scene, featuring detailed branches and leaves. The artwork shows fine brushstrokes detailing textures in rocks, water, and sky using a monochromatic color palette. Figures near the shoreline seem to be maneuvering a boat, while distant ships and a tower are visible against the water and sky, creating an atmosphere of movement and activity.

artworks.title: Aprilis (April)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is depicted with rolling hills and distant mountains. The foreground includes two figures engaged in an activity. The drawing style features fine lines showcasing the terrain, trees, and bushes. The color palette is monochromatic, using variations of black and white. The distant areas fade into the background, implying depth and vastness.

artworks.title: Mayus (May)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene with a body of water, mountains in the distance, and trees in the foreground. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting textures like clouds and foliage. The illustration is in black and white, emphasizing contrast through shading. Trees frame the right side, and a boat with three figures is seen rowing. Rugged hills rise from the water, their surface textured with stippling to match the serene clouds.

artworks.title: Iunius (June)
artworks.description: The landscape is observed from an elevated or mid-level viewpoint. The horizon is towards the upper third of the image, marked by distant hills. The etching technique gives a detailed style, with fine lines showing textures of the landscape and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. Large trees with canopies frame the scene on the left, shrubbery and smaller trees on the right. A winding path leads into the scene where figures and animals are moving. In the distance, gently sloping hills provide scale, with sparse clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Lulius (July)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with a church structure positioned off-center to the left. The church is surrounded by lush trees and bushes, creating a tranquil setting. The horizon is low, allowing the church and landscape to dominate the composition. Linear brushstrokes create textures in the greenery, clouds, and architectural details, enhancing the atmosphere. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of gray. Two small figures are walking along a path to the left, and hills rise in the distance. The sky features swirling cloud formations.

artworks.title: Augustus (August)
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a village visible in the distance. A church tower with a cross stands out on the horizon. The art style is detailed with fine lines in a monochromatic color scheme dominated by various shades of black. The scene includes a river, a figure by the bank, village structures, trees, and hills in the background.

artworks.title: September
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a tree leaning over a small, dilapidated structure. A pair of barrels rest on the structure. The scene is depicted with fine etching techniques, using delicate lines to show texture in the foliage and structure. The color palette is monochromatic, with black and white used for shading. A winding path leads into the distance where small figures of people and a horse-drawn cart are visible. The sky dominates the upper part of the composition, with horizontal clouds. A faint silhouette of a hill is seen to the right. Lines are used for shading and texture in the landscape and sky.

artworks.title: October
artworks.description: This image displays a landscape with a rustic windmill slightly off-center and elevated above the horizon. The horizon is low, showcasing an expansive sky with stylized clouds rendered in fine, parallel lines. The brushstrokes (or engravings) detail the scene with hatching and cross-hatching for shading. Trees with dense foliage are depicted to the left, near a rocky outcrop. A dirt path leads to the windmill, where small figures are walking, with additional figures in the distance. Rolling hills with trees and buildings lead to distant rising hills. The color palette is primarily sepia, typical of engraved prints, giving the scene a nostalgic quality.

artworks.title: November
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic landscape with buildings, a river, trees, and mountains. The scene is created using delicate lines and cross-hatching techniques for texture. In the foreground, there are thatched-roof buildings on a hill, a tree, and a herdsman with sheep. The color scheme is monochrome in varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: December
artworks.description: The image shows a scenic landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, showcasing a wide sky with linear clouds formed by delicate brushstrokes. The scene depicts a wintry environment with varying shades of gray. A path winds through the scene with small figures walking. A hill with a leafless tree is central, alongside old stone ruins and an archway on the left. In the distance, there is a stone bridge over a watercourse and a tower nearby, framed by mountains fading into the horizon.

artworks.title: An Answer to the Print of John Wilkes Esq. by Wm. Hogarth
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features two individuals and a dog seated. The central figure is a man in a chair holding an artist's palette and brushes with curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat. Beside him is an intricately carved chair arm with a satyr face. Behind him, an older woman holds a mirror and a book. A dog stands next to the man. The setting includes an artist's workspace with a large canvas on an easel and a mug inscribed with "The laurel is for comic Art." The background is shaded with lines.

artworks.title: The Five Orders of Perriwigs as They Were Worn at the Late Coronation, Measured Architectonically
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various styles of periwigs arranged architectonically. The image depicts periwigs with labels and diagrams in a pseudo-scientific style reminiscent of architectural drawings. Each wig is shown in side profiles with letters and names referencing architectural elements. The drawing features several rows of wigs, with the top row on a pediment-like structure and the lower portion on heads in profile. Text adds satirical and informative context to the illustration, framing periwigs as grand fashion statements akin to monumental architecture.

artworks.title: Satire on False Perspective
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the image, with a sky and scattered clouds above. There are trees, a small church-like structure with a steeple on the horizon. In the foreground, a man is standing with a fishing rod near barrels. A river winds through the scene with people rowing a boat under a bridge and herding sheep. The bridge spans the image, adding to the scene's architecture. The foliage and trees are intricately detailed using fine-lined engravings. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly black, gray, and white.

artworks.title: Noon
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy street scene in a town. Various people are depicted engaging in different activities along a narrow cobblestone street bordered by brick and wooden buildings. The architectural details include a church spire in the background and a sign for a "French Eating House" above one of the buildings. Several individuals, including children and adults, are interacting, with some appearing to converse theatrically. The image conveys an atmosphere of everyday life, emphasizing social interactions and street dynamics. The drawing is rich with details that could be seen as commentary on societal norms and interactions, conveyed through detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Evening
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic village scene during the evening. The image depicts a rural setting with various architectural elements and natural scenery. The drawing includes domestic animals, visible elements of buildings, a signboard, dramatic cloud formations, a fence, and various tools. It captures daily life in a past era, focusing on community and nature.

artworks.title: Night
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling night scene in an urban setting. It is depicted in a monochrome palette. The composition is detailed with a man looking out from beneath a window, a pail of water being emptied above him, and two individuals holding a lantern. There are various elements cluttering the street such as barrels, a broken cart wheel, and scattered litter. A tavern or alehouse sign hangs above, depicting a glass. In the background, a crescent moon illuminates the scene slightly, alongside swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Bacchus Accompanied by a Leopard and a Tiger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This drawing features two animals surrounded by a variety of fruit and an elaborate background. The image shows two large feline-like creatures entwined and adorned with intricate arrangements of fruit. To the right, excessive clusters of fruit are intertwined with a human-like figure's limbs and torso, posed dynamically beside the animals. The lines are defined and detailed, contributing to a richly textured scene filled with overlapping elements that create a sense of movement and vitality within the piece.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a sketch depicting the upper portion of a person's body, focusing on the face and head. The person is slightly turned to the right with their head facing forward, with detailed facial features including eyes, nose, and closed lips. The person has short hair covered by a cap or headscarf, and is wearing a garment with a visible collar around the neck. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: The French Barracks
artworks.medium: hand colored etching with aquatint (proof) on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This is a painting titled "French Barracks." The scene shows a crowded room with various people engaged in different activities. In the center, a group surrounds a seated individual. A figure in military attire stands to the right, interacting with a woman holding a object. Other figures, including children and a small dog, are also present. The room is decorated with weapons, shields, and a suit of armor in the background. The colors are muted, and the composition is detailed, reflecting the style of Thomas Rowlandson.
